name: Zutto Tsukushite Ageru no!
original_name: ずっとつくしてあげるの！
source:
Kentarou planned to leave his hometown after graduation to pursue his dream. Upon telling his osananajimis this, they demanded that he choose who will marry him before that happens! They started competing amongst themselves as to who would serve him the best. He told them that he will give them an answer by the end of the summer, which they thought to mean that this summer would be the last chance to appeal to him, adding more fuel to their battle for his heart. Who will he end up choosing… or rather, who will seize the spot by his side?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
山神健太郎打算畢業後離開故鄉，追逐自己的夢想。他把這個決定告訴幾位青梅竹馬後，她們卻要求他在動身前選出自己的結婚對象！少女們開始互相較勁，看誰能把他照顧得最好。健太郎答應會在夏天結束前給她們答覆，她們便認定這個夏天是最後的表現機會，為了贏得他的心，她們也爭得越來越激烈。最終，他會選擇誰……或者更準確地說，誰能搶到他身旁的位置？

[引自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
